title: Orsen and the Vow
author: P. M. Galloway
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
